THE HAMMER FALLING: the hammer just landing and a bright ring of sparks leaping outward from the hot bar in every direction
THE HAMMER AT REST: the hammer at the very top of its lift and the whole forge holding still for one quiet beat
THE SPARK CROWN: sparks leaping off the bar in a little crown and settling slowly down onto the stone floor
THE HAMMER RISING: the hammer climbing slowly back and a trail of warm light following it up through the bright air
THE HAMMER KISSING THE BAR: the hammer just meeting the bar and a scatter of small bright sparks skipping away across the anvil
THE HOOK TAKING WEIGHT: a hook finding the glowing bar and the chain above it going beautifully tight and still
THE BLADE SET DOWN: a finished blade just laid flat on cool stone and the heat shimmering gently up off it
THE MOULD LID LIFTING: the mould lid easing away and a warm spill of golden light opening out into the room
THE BAR LIFTED: a bright bar rising slowly on the chain and turning just a little as it finds its balance
THE COALS BRIGHTENING: the coals settling inward and brightening all at once into a warmer and more generous glow
THE LOG GIVING WAY: a log folding into the coals and the whole bright bed slumping and glowing more fully
THE FIRE DOOR CLOSING: the fire door easing shut and the room going softly warm and beautifully dim all around
THE COALS SETTLING: the coals shifting and brightening briefly as air moves up through them from somewhere below
RINGS IN THE TROUGH: rings spreading out slowly across the quench trough and touching the far edge and returning
THE STEAM THINNING: the last curl of steam thinning away above the trough until the air is perfectly clear again
THE DRIP LANDING: a drip falling from a wet chain and landing in the trough with one small bright flash
THE STEAM RISING: a soft white lift of steam rising from the trough and spreading wide and gentle near the ceiling
ONE EMBER RISING: a single bright ember sailing slowly upward into the dark above the forge and going quietly out
ASH TURNING: a wisp of ash lifting from a ledge and turning over once slowly before settling somewhere new
THE SOOT FLAKE: a flake of soot drifting down past the near edge of the light and out of sight
EMBERS ALOFT: two small embers rising together into the dark and parting ways somewhere above the chimney throat
THE GLOW REACHING UP: the furnace glow just reaching the carved keystone overhead and warming the old stone beautifully
LIGHT ON THE WALL: the last of a pour's light fading softly and slowly off the far wall and resting there
LIGHT ON THE STAIR: a warm patch of light climbing one stair tread and pausing there as if considering the next
THE GLOW FINDING STONE: the furnace glow reaching a high corbel and resting golden on its curved and patient face
